title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
婚礼的时候，靳吾栖没出现，程澈作为程宴的侄子兼伴郎，陪着他在酒店忙了一天，周舟作为周桥的弟弟兼……花童？陪着周桥在婚纱店嗑瓜子打游戏，与新郎那边形成鲜明对比。余炀在傍晚的时候还在和几个高层开会，结束后他看了眼手表，立刻抓起外套出了公司，打开手机，全是周舟的电话和微信。刚坐上车，周舟的电话又打过来了，余炀一边发动车子一边接起来。“你怎么还没到啊？”周舟那头的声音有些嘈杂，他几乎是扯着嗓子在跟余炀说话，跟只咩咩叫的小羊似的，“像话吗余炀？你知道今天是谁结婚吗？是你周桥姐！她已经问了我八百回你在哪了，说等会儿见到你非要把捧花塞你嘴里不可。”“谢谢周桥姐厚爱。”余炀说，“开车了，马上到。”“赶紧吧你！”周舟挂了电话，转身回宴会厅，结果一头撞在一个alpha的怀里。“做设计做傻了？路也不好好看。”程澈搂着他，问，“余炀来吗？”汜减汜“来。”周舟揣好手机，替程澈整理了一下领带，“你哥呢？来不来啊？”“不知道，电话打不通。”程澈拿手扒拉了一下周舟的头发，“谁给你设计的发型？小卷毛儿。”“呵，我姐。”周舟嘟起嘴往上吹了一下自己卷卷的刘海，忿忿地说，“她在婚纱店闲着没事拿我取乐，要不是看在她今天结婚的份儿上，我才不答应。”“没事，很可爱。”程澈低头在他的额头上亲了一下，“进去吧，婚礼要开始了。”路上有点堵，余炀下了车以后是跑进酒店大厅的，他的手里拿着外套，衬衫扣子都没扣好，领带也有点松，正要问问服务员在哪个宴厅，一抬头就看见了电子屏上周桥和程宴的名字，显示是在最大的宴会厅里。周舟的电话又打来了，余炀站在电梯里接起来：“别催了，就到了。”“你等着吃捧花吧！”周舟说，“待会儿从左边的门进来，我们在最前面一桌。”“知道了。”“唉，戒指已经交换完了，都没什么看头了，你才到，程澈他哥干脆没接电话，估计是来不了了……”&#29306&#22914&#32&#57&#98&#122&#119&#46&#99&#111&#109&#32&#29306&#22914靳吾栖不来。余炀匆匆出电梯的脚步诡异地放缓下来，他垂着眼听着电话，往宴厅大门走。明明抗拒再见面，却在知道对方也可能会出席时忍不住生出不可名状的期待，此刻突然被告知他不会来，又好像有一块石头在胸腔里滚滚落下，压住了心脏，整个人都有些无力和乏味，情绪被禁锢成畸形的僵硬冻状，无处释放。真的是……逃不了啊，一直都那么犯贱。余炀自嘲地笑了一声，挂断电话，伸手按在冰凉的门把手上，稍稍用力，打开了门。“余炀。”宴厅里的嘈杂人声透过门缝往外冒，背后那一声轻柔的叫喊却好像将所有的吵闹都重新推回了大厅，清晰地响在耳边，包裹住听觉，余炀整个人都滞住了。心跳飙升，余炀将门缝合上，然后转过头，看着身后的omega，明明情绪一路喧嚣快要冲破胸口，他的脸上却看不出一丝表情，仿佛这一年多来在商场上磨练出的演技给他穿上了自欺欺人的盔甲，让他起码能维持住淡薄的神情。靳吾栖仍是松松地扎着头发，碎发轻飘飘落在脸侧，他穿着一件简单柔软的毛衣，是最基础的不加修饰的款式，可是omega的那张脸太过艳丽动人，于是连带着毛衣都染上媚色，让人挪不开眼。“你也这么晚到？”靳吾栖柔柔地笑着，丝毫不见任何不妥的模样，“看来工作很忙。”余炀淡淡地别过头，重新拉开门，站在一边，以一种礼貌周到的姿势扶住门，他没有直视靳吾栖一眼，似乎无论此刻门外是谁，余炀都会这样礼节性地请对方先进厅。

靳吾栖从善如流地走过来，经过余炀身前时，他停住脚步，抬手拨弄了一下余炀松松的领带，甜媚的声音在喧闹的人声中像一把钩子，如有实感般地钻进余炀的耳朵里。“小绅士，领带系成这样，不乖啊。”两人贴得有些近，玫瑰香萦绕在鼻尖，余炀刻意低垂的视线里只能看见靳吾栖线条优美的下巴，他漠然抬眼对上那双茶色的眼睛，不置一词。确实是……变了啊。从前，少年看向他的时候，眼睛永远是带着亮色的，像燃烧的星辰，永不熄灭。而现在，那些光亮消失得彻底，被冷漠覆盖，像是淹没过心头的湖水，平静、疏离，又沉重，仿佛能将呼吸里的氧气尽数吞没。靳吾栖放下手，抿嘴笑了笑，与余炀擦身进了宴会厅。余炀关上门，他知道自己很大概率会被安排在和靳吾栖一桌，于是跟在了靳吾栖身后走。大厅的灯光被刻意调低，只剩台上明亮，余炀在变换的昏暗光线里注视的眼前不远处omega白皙修长的后颈，腺体被凌碎的尾发和毛衣领子挡着，看不清，可是余炀记得的，他曾经咬破过那个散发着玫瑰香的脆弱柔嫩的腺体，将自己的柠檬汽水信息素凶狠地灌进omega的身体里，他标记过靳吾栖的。可也只不过，是暂时标记而已，留不住，半个月就能褪个干净，无济于事。本章未完，请点击下一页继续阅读，后面更精彩！芈何芈标记留不住，人也留不住，不告而别，一走就是四年多，想想也是可笑。台上的人说了什么他没听清，在宾客的热烈掌声和欢呼声里，余炀看见了周舟和程澈，靳吾栖走在他前面，朝周舟挥了挥手。周舟从椅子上蹿起来，跑到靳吾栖面前去拥抱他，一边在他耳边兴奋地说着话。倒是程澈侧头看见了靳吾栖身后的余炀，朝他点点头。余炀于是绕过靳吾栖走到桌边坐下，程澈给他推过来一杯酒。“不喝，还要开车。”余炀说，“喝饮料就行。”程澈看了一眼正在说话的周舟和靳吾栖，说：“我哥刚回来不久。”“嗯。”余炀喝了口饮料。程澈支着头，边看着台上边跟余炀说话：“一个星期前回来的吧，听说很忙，前两天才跟我见了一面，也没空给我叔叔当伴郎。”余炀看着手里的杯子。一个星期前，那就是上次在篮球场第一次见面的那天。&#29306&#22914&#32&#55&#53&#122&#119&#111&#114&#103&#46&#99&#111&#109&#32&#29306&#22914说不定自己是靳吾栖回国以后见的第一个人。汜减汜可是余炀只觉得好笑，靳吾栖这样的手段在四年前就用过无数次，每次回国都第一个来找余炀，仿佛将他看得比什么都重要。可结果呢？靳吾栖离开的时候，唯独没有跟余炀告别，甩他甩得干脆利落。周舟和靳吾栖走过来坐下了，余炀仰头把杯子里的饮料喝干净，然后放下杯子看着周桥和程宴，跟其他人一起鼓着掌，他淡淡地对程澈说：“别再提了。”程澈看着余炀，然后随着余炀的视线一起望向台上，他说：“好。”芈何芈喜欢长夏醒迟abo请大家收藏：长夏醒迟abo更新速度最快。

During the wedding, Jin Wuqi didn't show up. Cheng Che, as Cheng Yan's nephew and best man, stayed with him for a busy day at the hotel. Zhou Zhou, as Zhou Qiao's younger brother and... flower girl?Accompanying Zhou Qiao in the bridal shop, eating melon seeds and playing games, which was in sharp contrast to the groom.Yu Yang was still in a meeting with several senior executives in the evening. After he looked at his watch, he immediately grabbed his coat and left the company. When he turned on his phone, he saw Zhou Zhou's phone calls and WeChat messages.As soon as he got in the car, Zhou Zhou called again, and Yu Yang picked up the call while starting the car."Why haven't you arrived yet?" Zhou Zhou's voice on the other end was a little noisy. He was talking to Yu Yang at the top of his lungs, like a bleating lamb. "Are you talking to Yu Yang? Do you know who is getting married today? It's your sister Zhou Qiao! She has asked me eight hundred times where you are.I said I will put the bouquet in your mouth when I see you later." "Thank you, Sister Zhou Qiao, for your kindness." Yu Yang said, "I'll be there soon." "Hurry up!" Zhou Zhou hung up the phone and turned back to the banquet hall, only to bump into an alpha's arms."Are you stupid about designing? The road doesn't look good either." Cheng Che hugged him and asked, "Is Yu Yang coming?" Si added Si "Come." Zhou Zhou put away his cell phone and straightened Cheng Che's tie, "Where's your brother? Is he coming?" "I don't know, I can't call you."Yes."Cheng Che pulled Zhou Zhou's hair with his hand, "Who designed your hair?""Oh, my sister."Zhou Zhou pouted and blew up his curly bangs and said angrily, "She had nothing to do with me in the wedding dress shop.Just for fun, I wouldn't agree if it weren't for her getting married today."It's okay, it's very cute."Cheng Che lowered his head and kissed him on the forehead, "Let's go in, the wedding is about to start."There was a bit of traffic on the road, so Yu Yang ran away after getting out of the car.When he entered the hotel lobby, he had a coat in his hand, his shirt was unbuttoned, and his tie was a little loose. He was about to ask the waiter which banquet hall he was in. When he looked up, he saw the names of Zhou Qiao and Cheng Yan on the electronic screen, which showed that they were in the largest banquet hall.Zhou Zhou's call came again, and Yu Yang stood in the elevator to answer it: "Don't rush me, we're here." "Just wait and eat the bouquet!" Zhou Zhou said, "Come in from the door on the left later, we will be at the front table." "Got it." "Oh, the rings have been exchanged, and there is nothing to see. You just arrived, and Cheng Che's brother simply didn't answer the phone, so he probably won't be able to come..."&#29306&#22914&#32&#57&#98&#122&#119&#46&#99&#111&#109&#32&#29306&#22914Jin Wuqi can’t come.Yu Yang's steps as he hurried out of the elevator slowed down strangely. He listened to the phone with his eyes lowered and walked towards the banquet hall door.She obviously resisted meeting again, but she couldn't help but feel indescribable expectations when she knew that the other party might also attend. At this moment, she was suddenly told that he would not come, and it was like a stone rolled down in her chest, suppressing her heart. Her whole person felt weak and boring, and her emotions were trapped in a deformed, frozen state with no place to release.I really...can't escape, I've always been so mean.Yu Yang laughed to himself, hung up the phone, put his hand on the cold door handle, and opened the door with a little force."Yu Yang." The noisy voices in the banquet hall came out through the crack in the door, but the soft shout behind him seemed to push all the noise back into the hall, ringing clearly in his ears, covering his hearing, and Yu Yang's whole body froze.With his heart beating soaring, Yu Yang sewed the door shut, then turned his head and looked at the omega behind him. Although his emotions were about to break through his chest, there was no expression on his face. It was as if the acting skills he had honed in the mall for more than a year had put on the armor of self-deception, allowing him to at least maintain an indifferent expression.Jin Wuqi still tied his hair loosely, with broken hair falling lightly on the side of his face. He was wearing a simple and soft sweater, which was the most basic and unadorned style. However, the omega's face was too gorgeous and attractive, so even the sweater was dyed with a charming color, making it difficult for people to take their eyes away."Are you arriving so late too?" Jin Wuqi smiled softly, without any sign of anything wrong, "Looks like he's very busy at work." Yu Yang turned away indifferently, opened the door again, stood aside, and held the door in a polite and considerate manner. He did not look directly at Jin Wuqi. It seemed that no matter who was outside the door at the moment, Yu Yang would politely ask him to go into the hall first.

Jin Wuqi walked over calmly. When he passed by Yu Yang, he stopped and raised his hand to fiddle with Yu Yang's loose tie. His sweet voice was like a hook in the noisy crowd, drilling into Yu Yang's ears as if it was real."Young gentleman, you're not being nice with your tie like this." The two of them were a little close, and the scent of rose lingered on the tip of their noses. Yu Yang's deliberately lowered gaze could only see Jin Wuqi's graceful chin. He raised his eyes indifferently and met those brown eyes without saying a word.It's true... it's changed.In the past, when the young man looked at him, his eyes would always be bright, like burning stars that would never go out.But now, those lights have completely disappeared, covered by indifference, like a lake that has submerged in the heart, calm, alienated, and heavy, as if it can swallow up all the oxygen in the breath.Jin Wuqi put down his hand, smiled, and walked into the banquet hall with Yu Yang.Yu Yang closed the door. He knew that there was a high probability that he would be placed at the same table as Jin Wuqi, so he followed Jin Wuqi.The lights in the hall were deliberately lowered, leaving only the stage bright. Yu Yang stared at the fair and slender nape of the omega not far away in the changing dim light. The glands were blocked by the messy tail hair and sweater collar and could not be seen clearly. However, Yu Yang remembered that he had bitten the fragile and tender glands that smelled of roses, and poured his lemonade pheromones fiercely into the omega's body. He had marked Jin Wuqi's body.But it's just a temporary mark. It can't be retained. It will fade away in half a month, which is of no use.This chapter is not finished yet, please click on the next page to continue reading, there will be more exciting things to come!Mi Ho Mi can't keep the mark, nor can the person stay. It's ridiculous to think about leaving without saying goodbye and staying away for more than four years.He didn't hear what the people on the stage said clearly. Amidst the warm applause and cheers of the guests, Yu Yang saw Zhou Zhou and Cheng Che. Jin Wuqi walked in front of him and waved to Zhou Zhou.Zhou Zhou jumped up from his chair, ran to Jin Wuqi, hugged him, and spoke excitedly in his ear.However, Cheng Che turned his head and saw Yu Yang sitting behind Jin Wu and nodded towards him.Yu Yang then walked around Jin Wuqi and sat down at the table. Cheng Che pushed him a glass of wine."If you don't drink, you have to drive." Yu Yang said, "Just a drink." Cheng Che glanced at Zhou Zhou and Jin Wuqi who were talking and said, "My brother just came back not long ago." "Yeah." Yu Yang took a sip of the drink.Cheng Che propped his head and looked at the stage while talking to Yu Yang: "I came back a week ago, I heard. I heard he was very busy. He only met me two days ago and he didn't have time to be my uncle's best man." Yu Yang looked at the cup in his hand.A week ago, that was the day we last met for the first time on the basketball court.&#29306&#22914&#32&#55&#53&#122&#119&#111&#114&#103&#46&#99&#111&#109&#32&#29306&#22914 Maybe he is the first person Jin Wuqi sees after returning to China.Si subtracting Si, but Yu Yang only found it funny. Jin Wuqi had used this method countless times four years ago. Every time he returned to China, he was the first to come to Yu Yang, as if he was more important than anything else.But what's the result?When Jin Wuqi left, he did not say goodbye to Yu Yang, and dumped him cleanly.Zhou Zhou and Jin Wuqi came over and sat down. Yu Yang raised his head and drank the drink in the cup. Then he put down the cup and looked at Zhou Qiao and Cheng Yan. He applauded with the others. He said lightly to Cheng Che: "Don't mention it again." Cheng Che looked at Yu Yang, and then followed Yu Yang's gaze to the stage. He said, "Okay."

靳吾栖从善如流地走过来，经过余炀身前时，他停住脚步，抬手拨弄了一下余炀松松的领带，甜媚的声音在喧闹的人声中像一把钩子，如有实感般地钻进余炀的耳朵里。“小绅士，领带系成这样，不乖啊。”两人贴得有些近，玫瑰香萦绕在鼻尖，余炀刻意低垂的视线里只能看见靳吾栖线条优美的下巴，他漠然抬眼对上那双茶色的眼睛，不置一词。确实是……变了啊。从前，少年看向他的时候，眼睛永远是带着亮色的，像燃烧的星辰，永不熄灭。而现在，那些光亮消失得彻底，被冷漠覆盖，像是淹没过心头的湖水，平静、疏离，又沉重，仿佛能将呼吸里的氧气尽数吞没。靳吾栖放下手，抿嘴笑了笑，与余炀擦身进了宴会厅。余炀关上门，他知道自己很大概率会被安排在和靳吾栖一桌，于是跟在了靳吾栖身后走。大厅的灯光被刻意调低，只剩台上明亮，余炀在变换的昏暗光线里注视的眼前不远处omega白皙修长的后颈，腺体被凌碎的尾发和毛衣领子挡着，看不清，可是余炀记得的，他曾经咬破过那个散发着玫瑰香的脆弱柔嫩的腺体，将自己的柠檬汽水信息素凶狠地灌进omega的身体里，他标记过靳吾栖的。可也只不过，是暂时标记而已，留不住，半个月就能褪个干净，无济于事。本章未完，请点击下一页继续阅读，后面更精彩！芈何芈标记留不住，人也留不住，不告而别，一走就是四年多，想想也是可笑。台上的人说了什么他没听清，在宾客的热烈掌声和欢呼声里，余炀看见了周舟和程澈，靳吾栖走在他前面，朝周舟挥了挥手。周舟从椅子上蹿起来，跑到靳吾栖面前去拥抱他，一边在他耳边兴奋地说着话。倒是程澈侧头看见了靳吾栖身后的余炀，朝他点点头。余炀于是绕过靳吾栖走到桌边坐下，程澈给他推过来一杯酒。“不喝，还要开车。”余炀说，“喝饮料就行。”程澈看了一眼正在说话的周舟和靳吾栖，说：“我哥刚回来不久。”“嗯。”余炀喝了口饮料。程澈支着头，边看着台上边跟余炀说话：“一个星期前回来的吧，听说很忙，前两天才跟我见了一面，也没空给我叔叔当伴郎。”余炀看着手里的杯子。一个星期前，那就是上次在篮球场第一次见面的那天。&#29306&#22914&#32&#55&#53&#122&#119&#111&#114&#103&#46&#99&#111&#109&#32&#29306&#22914说不定自己是靳吾栖回国以后见的第一个人。汜减汜可是余炀只觉得好笑，靳吾栖这样的手段在四年前就用过无数次，每次回国都第一个来找余炀，仿佛将他看得比什么都重要。可结果呢？靳吾栖离开的时候，唯独没有跟余炀告别，甩他甩得干脆利落。周舟和靳吾栖走过来坐下了，余炀仰头把杯子里的饮料喝干净，然后放下杯子看着周桥和程宴，跟其他人一起鼓着掌，他淡淡地对程澈说：“别再提了。”程澈看着余炀，然后随着余炀的视线一起望向台上，他说：“好。”芈何芈喜欢长夏醒迟abo请大家收藏：长夏醒迟abo更新速度最快。
